summary: The v45 cockatrice/newt mismatch is a missing call in the monster-versus-monster AD_STON arm of uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_ston. At step 68 C displays “The newt turns to stone!” and runs do_stone_mon; JavaScript skips that already implemented helper behind note_unported and leaves the newt alive. The reported next_ident RNG mismatch is downstream of C monstone creating a statue or rock, not a defect in mkobj.c:next_ident. Wire the complete existing do_stone_mon implementation in the uncancelled monster-versus-monster branch, preserve mhm.done handling, and leave the helper’s return unused.

source.branch: In mhitm_ad_ston, when neither participant is the hero, return early if magr->mcan; otherwise call do_stone_mon(magr, mattk, mdef, mhm), then return if the helper sets mhm->done. The selected attack is an uncancelled cockatrice AT_TUCH/AD_STON against a nonresistant newt.
callers: Direct source caller: uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping dispatches AD_STON to mhitm_ad_ston at line 4796; js/uhitm.js:mhitm_adtyping already awaits the same handler.

Selected runtime path: monmove.c:dochug -> mhitm.c:mattackm -> mhitm.c:mdamagem -> uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping -> uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_ston -> uhitm.c:do_stone_mon. JavaScript mirrors this through js/mhitm.js:mdamagem and the existing js/uhitm.js dispatcher.
The unchanged other dispatcher entries are uhitm.c:damageum for hero-to-monster and mhitu.c:hitmu for monster-to-hero; their JavaScript callers already reach the shared dispatcher.
dependencies: uhitm.c:do_stone_mon is already implemented in js/uhitm.js and has source-pinned tests; commit 6f2da0bd9 added it for the physical petrifying-corpse branch in mhitm_ad_phys. This task wires its second source caller and verifies the helper through the selected recorded monster-versus-monster path.

do_stone_mon calls muse.c:munstone, uhitm.c:poly_when_stoned/mon_to_stone, mon.c:resists_ston/monstone and grow_up; these canonical owners already exist and the selected nonresistant newt reaches monstone.

The existing hero-to-monster branch still names the discarded void trap.c:minstapetrify call with note_unported. The monster-to-hero branch retains the existing potion.c:make_stoned gap reached only when do_stone_u starts hero stoning. Neither gap is the selected branch or should be replaced with invented behavior.
